about: Who can be in a comic. `run` is the end of a run folder's name (the part after its date). `version` is the rigged file to draw: profiles/<version>-walk.glb for hand-written poses, profiles/<version>-<clip>.glb for a moment of a clip. `face` says how a drawn expression goes on the head: `whole` covers the face, `eyes` only the strip a mask leaves open; `region` is that area as fractions of the head seen from the front (left, top, right, bottom); `lighten` brightens the drawn face when it comes out darker than the head around it. `clips` lists the clips whose moments a panel may freeze; one made from a shot names the shot, and its poses become named moments.

lincoln.name: Lincoln
lincoln.about: young Abraham Lincoln as a tall, lanky frontier wrestler in a linen shirt and rolled trousers; dry, patient, kind

roosevelt.name: Roosevelt
roosevelt.about: Theodore Roosevelt as a stocky 1890s wrestler in a navy singlet, round glasses and a big mustache; loud, cheerful, tireless

ninja.name: Ninja
ninja.about: a stocky ninja in a dark hooded suit and mask, only the eyes showing, a katana on the back; very serious about being stealthy

troll.name: Troll
troll.about: a huge, heavy cave troll with a small head sunk between massive shoulders; slow and gentle

pirate.name: Pirate
pirate.about: a stocky pirate deckhand in a tricorn hat and a short navy coat; boastful

lizardkin.name: Lizardkin
lizardkin.about: an upright lizard-folk warrior with green scales and a heavy tail; proud and literal-minded

dancer.name: Dancer
dancer.about: a flamenco dancer in a black top and a long red ruffled skirt; dramatic
